hypothesis: The x and residual GM streams are loaded into distinct ping-pong TBufs and consumed together by conversion/add operations. Reversing which logical stream occupies the first allocated TBuf may alter operand-to-address placement interactions. This is an order-only probe; it does not claim a particular physical UB bank mapping. Both buffers have equal extents and transfer phase constants, so the effect may be neutral.
